name: OpenAI Agents API
description: OpenAI Agents API harness with hosted or self-hosted sessions.

environment.description: Execution environment for new sessions. Self-hosted uses the prepared OpenClaw workspace and requires an externally connected executor. Reset existing sessions after changing this setting.

openai_host.description: OpenAI-hosted environment settings. Unused for self-hosted sessions.

network.description: Native Agents API network policy. Reset existing sessions after adding, changing, or removing this policy. The API validates domain rules.

allowed_domains.description: Exact hostnames allowed in restricted mode. Subdomains and redirect destinations require separate entries.

hostExecutorSkillDirectories.description: Unique absolute paths without . or .. path segments on the executor host machine that already contain the skill files and are available to the Agents API harness. OpenClaw does not copy or install these files. Gateway skill eligibility filters do not apply to these directories. Reset existing sessions after changing this list.
